excerpt: One key, hundreds of models. Access models from multiple providers with a single API key
Unified API. Switch between providers and models with minimal code changes
High reliability. Automatically retries requests to other providers if one fails
Embeddings support. Generate vector embeddings for search, retrieval, and other tasks
Spend monitoring. Monitor your spending across different providers
No markup on tokens. Tokens cost the same as they would from the provider directly, with zero markup, including with [Bring Your Own Key (BYOK)]
You can use existing OpenAI client libraries, switch to AI Gateway with a URL change, and keep your current tools and workflows without code rewrites.
vercel ai-gateway coding-agents setup
You can use `order`, `only`, and `sort` in `providerOptions.gateway` to control which providers handle your requests, in what order, and how they are ranked.
You can set per-provider timeouts to trigger fast failover when a provider is slow to respond.
You can use `caching: 'auto'` in `providerOptions.gateway` to let AI Gateway automatically apply the appropriate caching strategy based on the provider.
The Requests section displays summaries by project, API key, and a detailed log of all requests.
If a query using your credentials fails, AI Gateway will retry the query with its system credentials to improve service availability.
For applications deployed on Vercel, OIDC tokens are automatically available as `VERCEL_OIDC_TOKEN`. No secrets to manage, no keys to rotate.
This endpoint requires no authentication and returns detailed information including model IDs, context windows, and pricing.
To cap how much your team, a project, an API key, or a team member can spend, set [budgets]
Move an existing provider integration | [Migrate to AI Gateway](/docs/ai-gateway/getting-started/migrate-to-ai-gateway)
Point your existing OpenAI or Anthropic SDK at AI Gateway. Same calls, no rewrites.
No markup on tokens. Tokens cost the same as they would from the provider directly, with zero markup, including with Bring Your Own Key (BYOK)
You can use order, only, and sort in providerOptions.gateway to control which providers handle your requests, in what order, and how they are ranked.
You can use caching: 'auto' in providerOptions.gateway to let AI Gateway automatically apply the appropriate caching strategy based on the provider.
For applications deployed on Vercel, OIDC tokens are automatically available as VERCEL_OIDC_TOKEN. No secrets to manage, no keys to rotate. It just works.

open the Logs page, where you can search by request ID, filter by model, provider, or status code, follow requests live, and open one request to see how it was routed. You can also export the filtered list as CSV or JSON.
AI Gateway routes requests, manages fallbacks and budgets, monitors usage, and connects supported coding agents.
Query the models endpoint directly to get a JSON list of all available models with pricing and capabilities
you can pass provider credentials on a per-request basis using the byok option in providerOptions.gateway. This is useful when you need to use different credentials for specific requests
You can use the AI Gateway's Chat Completions API with existing tools and libraries like the OpenAI client libraries and AI SDK. Point your existing client to the AI Gateway's base URL
You can also use `sort` to rank providers by a performance or cost metric. The gateway sorts providers by the chosen metric and tries them in that order
The Usage section displays four metrics to help you monitor your AI Gateway activity.
Move existing OpenAI, Anthropic, and AI SDK integrations to AI Gateway with a base URL swap.
Use one managed gateway from any infrastructure to centralize credentials, log requests, control spend, and fail over across providers.
The AI Gateway's unified API provides flexibility, allowing you to switch between different AI models and providers without rewriting parts of your application.

AI Gateway provides OpenAI Chat Completions API endpoints, letting you use multiple AI providers through a familiar interface. You can use existing OpenAI client libraries, switch to AI Gateway with a URL change
By default, Vercel AI Gateway dynamically chooses the default providers to give you the best experience based on a combination of recent uptime and latency.
The AI Gateway logs spend, model usage, and observability metrics related to your requests, which you can use to monitor and debug.
Using your own credentials with an external AI provider allows AI Gateway to authenticate requests on your behalf with no added markup.
Every request to AI Gateway requires Vercel authentication. Use an AI Gateway API key or OpenID Connect (OIDC) token.

AI Gateway charges no markup and no platform fee on tokens. You pay the provider's list price on a pay-as-you-go basis. Purchase AI Gateway Credits and Vercel automatically deducts charges from your balance.
AI Gateway API keys belong to a Vercel team and work in local development, CI, external servers, and Vercel deployments.
Access hundreds of models for text, image, and video generation, realtime voice, speech to text, text to speech, embeddings, and reranking through one API.
